title: RK ROYAL KLUDGE H81 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard $77.96, R98 Pro Wired $75.30, M3 Mouse $29.70 Delivered @ Royal Kludge
body:
Deal: RK ROYAL KLUDGE H81 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard $77.96, R98 Pro Wired $75.30, M3 Mouse $29.70 Delivered @ Royal Kludge

[Carteric] I've always wanted to get a wireless mechanical keyboard, but I have no idea about them at all. How about this brand?
[Sleepycat3] They are good for the price. I have the RK61 (metal) and RK68. Make sure you get good switches that match the style you want. I use Gateron Milky Yellow, and more recently switched 1 keyboard to Gateron Jade mechanical switches (not magnetic).
[buellersdayoff] https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=8ta4dSQ-P9c
[bchliu] It's excellent. I have it hooked up to my phone docking station to my monitor or big screen and it works well.
[beOson] This is a good mechanical keyboard for beginners, plastic but solid and with ok switches and keycaps. Just make sure you don't get the White Night version. Someone here once said it looked like a washing machine, and ever since then I haven't been able to unsee it. 😂
[billybob2015] ordered one from a few deals back, claimed to try to deliver on a Wednesday at 1.34pm and said we where closed, since it is getting delivered to a business that shuts at 5, then i think they are dreaming.
[chickentaste] I own a couple of RK keebs. They're all excellent for the price. Well built, good features, look great. My favourite is the Christmas themed one I was given as a present by my coworkers last year. Would recommend to anyone.
[chickentaste] https://rkgamingstore.com/products/s98-winter-limited-editio…
This one if you're interested
[BushRangerJones] Look I like these keyboards and I think they aren’t bad for the price but I’ve seen like 5 posts now… I don’t think these are deals anymore, it’s just the normal price masquerading as a deal. For those looking to buy, my opinion only.
[Amumu] both RK and Keychorn wireless keyboard will died within 1-2 years. poor quality control, pcb issues.
i have moved back to good old logitec AAA batteries ones
[Sleepycat3] Haven't had that issue with RK and Keychron. I have had this with Akko keyboards, 2 out of 3 failures with their wireless models. No issues with wired models, they all work really well if they are the wired version.
[OzGardian] happy with mine, replaced only the keycaps since the switches sound great already
